list.deleteSelectedDescription: Are you sure you want to delete these patients? This action cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete Patient
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.description: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave this page?

notes.title: Session Notes
notes.empty: No notes available for this session.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Time from session start to completion, shown in minutes.

averageProgress.title: Average progress
averageProgress.description: Average progress (%) across all exercises in this session.

bestRepetition.title: Best repetition
bestRepetition.description: Your highest movement score from a single repetition in this session.

consistency.title: Movement consistency
consistency.description: How much your repetition scores varied. Lower values mean more consistent scores, even if those scores were low.

fatigue.title: Fatigue drop-off
fatigue.description: Compares earlier and later repetition scores. Positive values mean scores dropped; negative values mean scores improved.

firstToLast.title: First set → Last set
firstToLast.description: Compares your average score in the first and last sets. Positive values mean improvement; negative values mean a decline.

volume.title: Total Repetitions (Volume)
volume.description: An estimate based on sets, repetitions, hold time and speed. Higher values represent more planned load.

visitConsistency.title: Visit consistency
visitConsistency.description: Average number of days between completed sessions in the selected range. Sessions on the same day count as one visit.
visitConsistency.footnote: Gaps longer than {{days}} days are listed below.

sessionDuration.title: Session duration
sessionDuration.description: Average time from session start to completion across completed sessions in the selected range.

volume.description: Sum of the planned load (sets, repetitions, hold time and speed) across completed sessions in the selected range. Higher values represent more planned load.
